svg.desc: 370 real consecutive dates, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-30, woven into seven weekday strands. Each faceted cell represents one actual day. Logarithmic height and light encode its count. Only decorative energy travels; cells and counts never change. Activity is not a skill score.

svg.text: Seven weekday strands. One real calendar.
One facet per actual day. Height and light use log(1 + count).
